I replied to Dana in her thread: the deadline is 21 December. That date comes from a single source, Marcus's post in #north-team on 14 October. No one there has posted a different date since. It's a date, not a money figure, so anyone on the North team can see it.

I couldn't check it against Thornbury's account files because none show up for me. I suggested she confirm with Marcus if she needs it checked before it goes in the tracker.
